integrity: The proof derives the graph as a disjoint union of clique and balanced complete-bipartite components, proves the zero-forcing minima componentwise, and matches them with explicit real symmetric low-rank block matrices. The maximum-nullity inequality then forces equality.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite commutative local rings that are not fields.
The minimum-rank statement is for real symmetric matrices.
For nonlocal rings the zero-divisor set need not be an ideal, so the component decomposition does not apply.
A 2020 paper computes nearby zero-forcing data for a nil-ideal total graph on Z_n that retains the zero vertex; that coverage is distinct but relevant.
title: Zero forcing and minimum rank of local total graphs with zero deleted
